notes.text: The page asserts connectedness equivalence and a pi_0 correspondence between a surface and its MD graph, then records a total genus formula in the margin. These are transcribed claims, not independently proved statements in this reading.
The special case has no Sigma, and the handwritten empty-set sign is phi-shaped. The graph description states that all edges are free and the vertices isolated apart from these edges.
The first diagram contains a simeq and an equals sign between the vector-A terms. The second equality initially resembled a single dash at half scale; the enlarged crop shows two strokes.
The text literally reads correspond : choisir rho=0, with a colon. The comma after the tuple before donné is also preserved despite the unusual punctuation.

The last paragraph has layered revisions. Its upper caractérisé may itself be cancelled. No missing participle is supplied to improve the resulting sentence. The type phrase is cancelled, while structure appears live with the continuation of the stroke below it.

The marginal drawing has five weighted vertices: g_0 carries three rays, g_1 and g_2 none, g_3 four, and g_4 one. The enclosing stroke has a compact left-pointing lower end. No finite edge joins two vertices.
The heading number is 5); a separate paler 48 is written at the bottom left. The latter is visually a different hand or numbering layer. Both have been transcribed.

Reading record: original viewed once for layout and each prepared half once line by line; all cited crops viewed. The oblique margin crop was widened before its unresolved right end was decided, and the still-open cancelled marginal formula received its own tight crop. No OCR, web consultation, other page packet, or TeX compilation was used. The line count includes separate interlinear/marginal lines, diagram rows, five drawing-label rows, and both page numbers.
